About us

Premium Drones Georgia is the official and exclusive XAG dealer in the Caucasus region.

Our story

Experience earned in the field.

PDG was founded in 2022 and has worked in the field with agricultural drones since 2023. The team trained at XAG Academy in China, and with the XAG V40, P100 and P100 Pro we have handled batteries, charging, parts, service and operator preparation in practice. Our goal is to develop the XAG ecosystem in Georgia and the Caucasus region.

Our current focus is the XAG P150 MAX. We provide the full XAG ecosystem: drones, batteries, chargers, generators, parts, service and training — for farmers, service companies and government and municipal buyers.

About XAG

XAG is a world leader in agricultural drones and robots. Its team was formed in 2007–2008, and today it makes agricultural drones, rovers, a tractor autopilot and smart-farm devices. According to XAG, it holds the most patents in this field.

XAG aims to build the infrastructure of agriculture for the next 100 years, that will provide the world with sufficient, diversified, and safe food. In Georgia, PDG offers XAG equipment, parts, service and training.

Questions customers ask

What is a spraying drone?

A spraying drone is an agricultural drone that applies crop protection products over a field automatically, following a GPS/RTK route. With optional modules (RevoCast 5, RevoSling) the XAG P150 MAX also spreads granules and carries cargo.

How does drone spraying differ from conventional spraying?

The drone never drives into the field: no soil compaction or crop damage, it works on wet ground and slopes, applies a precise rate, and the operator stays away from the chemicals. Choose the product and rate with your agronomist.

How much does the XAG P150 MAX cost in Georgia?

XAG P150 MAX platform (RevoSpray 5): ₾41,999. Packages: Starter ₾75,999, Pro ₾87,999, Business ₾104,999. See what each includes and every price in the shop.

Where can I buy XAG drone parts?

From Premium Drones Georgia, the official XAG dealer. Original parts, batteries, chargers and generators are in stock in Georgia, with prices in the shop.

Does Premium Drones Georgia offer service in Georgia?

Yes. We do diagnostics, repairs and maintenance with original parts. Service is in Tbilisi (by appointment), with field support from Lagodekhi.

Can the P150 MAX be used for cargo transport?

Yes. With the RevoSling system (sold separately) the P150 MAX carries up to 80 kg of cargo, for example to deliver materials and equipment to hard-to-reach places. Contact us for details.

Can the P150 MAX spread granules?

Yes. With the RevoCast 5 module (sold separately) and its 115 L container, the P150 MAX spreads granular fertiliser, seed and other granules. See the specifications on the P150 MAX page.

Do you train drone operators?

Yes. PDG Academy teaches drone operation and care in practice, in the field.
